stories.headline: Fernandes Puts 123 Beyond All Reason
stories.deck: 123 hammer test31121 by 41 behind a Bruno Fernandes hat-trick and Haaland double
stories.body:
123 did not win a match this round, they conducted an audit. 76 to 35 over test31121, the widest margin the desk logged, and every number pointed one way.

B.Fernandes ran it: three goals, one assist, the R1, pick 1 doing exactly what a first overall is drafted to do. Haaland added two behind him and Groß chipped a goal and an assist. test31121 had no answer, and Georginio carrying a knock did not help the count.

Elsewhere the margins were tighter. test4 saw off testf 56 to 45, test1 edged test211 48 to 40, test3 nipped test31 38 to 28, and test2 held off test3331 49 to 40. Four honest results and one demolition.

123 sit at the top of the conversation after that. When your R1 pick returns thirteen points of goal involvement on his own and your R3 forward doubles up, the table looks after itself.

test4 keep pace with a win over testf, Cherki and Mbeumo both returning. test1, test3 and test2 all bank narrow ones. test31121 and test3331 are the men left counting what went wrong.

B.Fernandes walks in and takes the armband with him. Three and one for 123, the round's outstanding return, and nobody comes close. Haaland alongside him with the brace, Cherki matching the goal count for test4.

Across the middle Gibbs-White, Mbeumo and João Pedro all posted a goal and an assist apiece, the sort of dual returns that win weeks. Scott chipped in a goal and kept a clean sheet on test3331's ledger, a tidy shift for an R5, pick 48.

At the back Tarkowski scored for testf, while Dedić and Calafiori paired a clean sheet with an assist. Groß is the unlucky one to slide down the order, a goal and an assist for 123 and still not front of the queue on a day like this.

ties.line: test1 edged it 48 to 40, João Pedro's goal and assist not enough to save test211.
test3 home by 38 to 28, Gibbs-White returning a goal and an assist and Calafiori a clean sheet and an assist.
test4 by 56 to 45, Cherki and Mbeumo doing the damage against Tarkowski's goal for testf.
test2 held on 49 to 40, Scott and Dedić's clean-sheet returns not enough for test3331.
76 to 35. B.Fernandes three and one, Haaland two, Groß one and one. test31121 flattened.

stories.headline: Sunderland Bank The Sheet, 123 Cash It
stories.deck: Sunderland's clean sheet feeds a stack of defenders, with 123 doubling up on it
stories.body:
One goal, one clean sheet, and the Sunderland back line paid out across half the league. Reinildo and Hume both went 90 minutes for six apiece, and 123 banked twelve from the pair alone. Sits 76 to 35 over test31121, whose Berge managed two off the bench at Fulham. That one is all but done.

test211 rode the same wall. Roefs kept his sheet for six, Castagne added six more off 67 minutes, King chipped in two. Forty to 48 down against test1, so the clean sheet keeps it live rather than winning it.

test4 got the goal that mattered. Isidor on for 26 minutes and off the mark, five points from almost nothing, with E.Le Fée adding three on the sheet. Fifty-six to 45 over testf, whose men were all on the wrong end of it: Ballard and Xhaka held their clean sheet for six and three, N.Angulo blanked on a two. Leno's three saves earned test3331 three, but a keeper conceding once doesn't move the needle against test2.

stories.headline: Gibbs-White Puts Ten Past The Table
stories.deck: Gibbs-White's goal-and-assist double is the standout return from a 2-2 draw, hauling ten for test3.
stories.body:
Gibbs-White ran the Forest board. A goal, an assist, ten points from ninety minutes, and test3's edge over test31 hardens toward decided at 38-28. Nothing else in this fixture came close.

Ndoye backed him with a goal off 65 minutes, six for test3331, though test2 still holds 49-40 with Isak's own strike answering. Isak took six of his own, one goal in ninety. Munoz matched him for a goal but leaked a booking, five for test31.

Wirtz supplied one assist and got booked, four for test1 in a tie test211 sit ahead of at 48-40. Gakpo's assist made five for test211 before he came off on 70. N.Williams chipped an assist, four for test4.

The blanks bite. McAtee and Szoboszlai walked off with two points apiece and nothing to show. Aina played 85, picked up a yellow, returned zero. Gravenberch got 19 minutes and one point, barely a cameo for test1.

stories.headline: Groß Domestic Product Booms For 123
stories.deck: Groß hauls ten in Chelsea's win but 123's numbers stay academic in a decided tie.
stories.body:
Groß was the pick of the day. A goal and an assist from midfield, ninety minutes, ten points, and yet another line that says 123 keep printing and keep losing the argument. Lacroix's lone point and Neto's six padded the pile. Same problem: 76 to 35 over test31121, all but decided, another crooked scoreboard that still ends third somewhere.

test211's João Pedro did everything a forward can and one thing he shouldn't. A goal, an assist, and an own goal netted seven, enough to keep the nose in front of test1 at 40 to 48. Palmer answered with a goal and seven of his own for test1, Lavia matched it, and that tie stays live on the numbers even as the arrow points one way.

Brighton's back line was misery for the owners. De Cuyper played the ninety for nothing, Verbruggen shipped four and banked one save for a flat zero, and Dunk's booking dragged test3 into minus figures. Rogers found an assist for five in a losing cause. Kostoulas an assist and five off the bench for test31121, small change against a 41-point deficit.

testf's ledger reads Rogers for five, and the phantom keeps haunting: still short in a tie that leans testf's way at 56 to 45, but the blanks that dogged them elsewhere haven't stopped following the name around.

stories.headline: Schade Draws A Long Bow For 123
stories.deck: Schade and Calvert-Lewin trade sixes; 123 keep piling on points but still lead where it counts.
stories.body:
Schade did the damage for 123, the goal inside 87 minutes worth six and the only Leeds return that mattered to a wallet. Stach chipped two more from the same stable. Another double return, another mountain of points, and 123 sit 76 to 35 over test31121, all but done. Ampadu's ninety was a lonely two the other way.

Calvert-Lewin answered for test1, six of his own off the Brentford goal, Kelleher adding a save and a clean two behind him. Not enough. test211's Damsgaard banked the clean sheet before coming off on 68, Bogle a quiet two, and test211 hold 48 to 40, all but decided.

Lewis-Potter's assist gave test3331 five, but test2's Trafford stopped four for three and the tie leans 49 to 40 against them. Ajer booked for a single point, Justin ninety for two, Aaronson a half for one, Rodon barely a third of the pitch. Jensen never left the bench.

stories.headline: test3 Banks a City Slicker
stories.deck: test3's Ndiaye joins Manchester City from Everton for up to £65m.
stories.body:
Ndiaye is test3's, and now he is City's too. The winger moves from Everton in a deal reported up to £65m, and the shirt change is the only fact that matters here.

What it does to test3's returns nobody yet knows. New club, new competition for minutes, no word on where he slots. test3 holds the asset and waits like everyone else.

stories.headline: 123 Banks a Big-Money Backline
stories.deck: Lacroix, one of the summer's twenty priciest signings, sits on 123's roster.
stories.body:
The BBC's ledger of the window's twenty biggest fees runs from Enzo Fernandez down to Maxence Lacroix. Only the last name matters here: Lacroix belongs to 123.

What the fee buys on the pitch is 123's problem to solve, and the wire says nothing of minutes or fitness. For now it is a name on a list and a name on a roster, and both read the same.

stories.headline: Pedro Points The Way, test211 Still Short
stories.deck: test1 beat test211 48 to 40 despite Joao Pedro's goal and assist
stories.body: Eight points in it and the tie already put to bed, but the panel pulled up the chairs anyway. test1 48, test211 40, and the studio wanted a word about the one man who did his bit in a losing cause.

quotes.speaker: The anchor
quotes.line: test211 come up eight short. Where does it go wrong for them?

quotes.speaker: The analyst
quotes.line: For me, it's not Joao Pedro, is it. Goal and an assist, ninety minutes, take a bow.

quotes.speaker: The analyst
quotes.line: He does everything you ask. But one man can't carry forty against forty-eight, can he.

quotes.speaker: The analyst
quotes.line: Comfortable. That's a winning margin all day. Joao Pedro's the one dragging test211 anywhere near it.

quotes.speaker: The analyst
quotes.line: For me, if you're test211 you're asking who else turned up. Because he did.

stories.headline: 123 Post Forty, Bank Nothing But Third
stories.deck: 123 win by 41 in gameweek 2 but the margins elsewhere are tighter; testf score 94 and lose again.
stories.body: The press room fills for gameweek 2. Five winners, five losers, and one demolition that still cannot buy top billing. 123 turn a 41-point margin and answer questions about a table that refuses to reward them. testf take their seat, 94 on the board, beaten again, and the phrase phantom zero hangs unspoken over the row.

quotes.line: Forty-one is a nice number. Third is a nicer question for someone else.

quotes.speaker: test31121
quotes.line: We ran into a buzzsaw. Nothing to say that the scoreline hasn't already screamed.

quotes.speaker: testf
quotes.line: Ninety-four points. Two rounds, two defeats. I'd like a word with the fixture list.

quotes.speaker: test4
quotes.line: Eleven's a comfortable margin. We just kept our heads and let the board do the talking.

quotes.speaker: test3
quotes.line: Ten points, quiet win. Nothing clever from me, the lads returned.

stories.headline: Bruno Runs Deep, Dedić Runs Dry
stories.deck: B.Fernandes hauls at the head of the team of the week while Dedić's clean-sheet return rots on his own bench
stories.body:
B.Fernandes is the man of the week and it is not close. Three goals and an assist from midfield is the sort of line forwards dream about, and 123 got it from a man wearing the M. Everything else in the eleven orbits him.

The back three picked itself on the balance of goals and shutouts. Tarkowski went up and scored, a defender doing forward's work. Calafiori kept the sheet clean and still found an assist. And then there is Dedić, an assist and a clean sheet of his own, benched by his own manager at test3331, which is the loudest note in the whole side. The football does not care where you were sitting.

The midfield is where the week lived. Cherki's brace off the bench of nobody's imagination, Gibbs-White's goal and assist, Groß mirroring it, Scott chipping in a goal and a clean sheet from the middle. Five in a five-man line and each of them earned the shirt on merit, not on filler.

Up front Haaland's two and the twin one-and-assists from Mbeumo and João Pedro carry the front three without argument. Mbeumo doubling up as creator and finisher is the sort of shift that keeps a forward nailed on.

Spare a thought for the men left out. Scott's clean sheet from midfield is a rare thing, and it edged sharper claims. Nobody in this eleven blanked, nobody was carried. The 3-5-3 leans hard on that packed middle, and this week the middle held.

stories.headline: Points Table Lies, Scoreboard Tells Truth
stories.deck: 123 and testf are the two best sides going, and the record hides both.
stories.body:
The table has test2 and test3 top on maximum points, and neither has done anything to argue with. But 6 points off 96 and 93 is honest, unspectacular work. Beating test3331 by 9 and test31 by 10 is a win banked, not a statement made. They are where they are because they scheduled it right.

The real ceiling sits at third and ninth. 123 put up a league-high 103 and buried test31121 by 41, and the table thanks them with 3 points. testf scored 94, more than three sides sitting above them, and has nothing. That is not football failing, that is the fixture list. test3331 and testf are the two zeros, but only one of them looks like a team going nowhere.

ranks.line: League-high 103 and a 41-point demolition; third is an insult the scoreboard will correct.
97 and an eight-point win over a live test211 side; quietly the most complete of the winners.
Top of the table, 96 scored, and yet you sense they beat a corpse in test3331.
Two from two on 93, but ten past test31 flatters a side that has not been tested.
97 and eleven clear of testf, but the schedule handed them the softest zero to beat.
94 in defeat by eight; unlucky in the draw, not outclassed in the football.
94 scored and bottom-but-one on nothing; the phantom zero is a scheduling crime, not a form guide.
83 and beaten by ten; the points are real but the score is thin.
79 and a 41-point hiding; the lowest ceiling in the league right now.
91 across two and still winless; competitive on the scoreboard, invisible on the table, going backwards either way.

stories.headline: Left Behind, Marked Present
stories.deck: Five benched players did their jobs while their managers watched from the wrong end of the lineup.
stories.body:
test31121 leads the parade twice over. Yalcouyé rewarded the bench with a goal in 73 minutes, and Gvardiol chipped in an assist across 74, both from the wrong side of the team sheet. One manager, two men delivering to nobody.

Dedić kept a clean sheet over the full 90 for test3331 and added an assist for good measure, the complete defensive shift wasted. Davis matched the goal on the other flank of the ledger, 90 minutes and a strike, left out by test4.

Diarra needed only 18 minutes to log an assist for test1, the shortest cameo on the list and no less pointed for it. Five men, five contributions, none of them counted.

stories.headline: Two Deals, No Rush, Raya Waits
stories.deck: A quiet gameweek 2 window: only two moves made across the league.
stories.body:
Two deals. That is the week. test4 swapped one for one, test31 and testf added a body apiece and closed the laptop. No churn, no bidding war, no man passed hand to hand. If gameweek 2 had a pulse it kept it well hidden.

testf was the only mover with a grievance to nurse. A second body brought in, a second round of nothing to show for it. Ninety-four scored and beaten by eleven; the reinforcement arrives into a squad that keeps blanking through no fault of the numbers.

David Raya. Signed in hope, dropped without ceremony, survives on the waiver wire. No claim has come. He waits, unclaimed, a goalkeeper nobody wants and nobody will bury.

test4 alone traded rather than hoarded, one out to make room for one in. Everyone else stood pat. Two deals is quiet, and calling it anything else would be inflation.

quiz.q: How many deals were struck in the gameweek 2 window?
Which manager was the only one to drop a player as well as add one?
Name the dropped goalkeeper still sitting unclaimed on the wire.
Which two managers added a player without dropping anyone?
How many points did testf score before losing by eleven?
